steps.command:
mkdir -p /workspace/hardlink && cd /workspace/hardlink || exit 1
fstype=$(findmnt -no FSTYPE -T .); echo "fstype $fstype"
echo "source $(findmnt -no SOURCE -T .)"
target=$(findmnt -no TARGET -T .)
echo "mount_line $(awk -v t="$target" '$2 == t' /proc/mounts | tail -n 1)"
echo "mounts $(wc -l < /proc/mounts)"
upper=$(findmnt -no OPTIONS -T . | tr , '\n' | sed -n 's/^upperdir=//p')
upper_fstype=""; [ -n "$upper" ] && upper_fstype=$(findmnt -no FSTYPE -T "$upper" 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$upper_fstype" ] && echo "upper_fstype $upper_fstype"
echo "inodes_free $(df --output=iavail . | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')"
free=$(df -B1 --output=avail . | tail -n 1 | tr -d ' ')
echo "disk_free_bytes $free"
awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {print "mem_available_kib", $2}' /proc/meminfo
echo "kernel $(uname -r)"
case "$free" in (*[!0-9]*|'') ;; (*) [ "$free" -lt {param:free_bytes} ] && { echo "missed: not enough free disk"; exit 1; } ;; esac
limit=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max 2>/dev/null)
[ -n "$limit" ] && echo "cgroup_memory.max $limit"
shmem() { awk '$1 == "shmem" {print $2}' /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.stat 2>/dev/null; }
if [ -n "$limit" ] && [ "$limit" != "max" ] && [ "$limit" -lt 1152921504606846976 ] 2>/dev/null; then
  before=$(shmem); scale=1
else
  before=$(awk '/^Shmem:/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo); scale=1024
fi
echo "before_memory_bytes $(( ${before:-0} * scale ))"
dd if=/dev/zero of=memory-probe bs=1M count=$(( {param:probe_bytes} / 1048576 )) status=none || exit 1
if [ "$scale" = 1 ]; then after=$(shmem); else after=$(awk '/^Shmem:/ {print $2}' /proc/meminfo); fi
rm -f memory-probe
echo "after_memory_bytes $(( ${after:-0} * scale ))"
rise=""
case "$before$after" in (*[!0-9]*|'') ;; (*) rise=$(( (after - before) * scale )) ;; esac
echo "memory_rise_bytes ${rise:-unknown}"
inmem=not_fired
if [ "$fstype" = tmpfs ] || [ "$fstype" = ramfs ] || [ "$upper_fstype" = tmpfs ] || [ "$upper_fstype" = ramfs ]; then
  inmem=fired
elif [ -z "$rise" ]; then
  if [ "$fstype" = overlay ] && [ -z "$upper_fstype" ]; then inmem=inconclusive; fi
elif [ "$rise" -ge 214748365 ]; then
  inmem=fired
fi
echo "files_in_memory $inmem"

cd /workspace/hardlink || exit 1
xz -d -f stress-ng.xz || exit 1
chmod +x stress-ng || exit 1
sha=$(sha256sum stress-ng | cut -d' ' -f1) || exit 1
echo "stress-ng_sha256 $sha"
./stress-ng --version 2>/dev/null | head -n 1 | sed 's/^/stress-ng_version /'
[ "$sha" = "{param:tool.sha256}" ]
